page_title: MET 2-5 LYO | Metz v Lyon 25/01/2026, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' The referee checks his watch and blows his whistle to signal the end of this match.
90+3' The ball goes out of play. Metz are awarded a corner kick.
90+2' We are about to witness a subsitution. Remi Himbert (Lyon) for Afonso Moreira.
90+2' Paulo Fonseca decides to make a substitution. Endrick will be replaced by Adil Hamdani (Lyon).
90+1' Metz are bossing possession at the moment by exchanging some precise passes from player to player.
90' There will be a minimum of 5 min. of added time.
87' Here's the change. Gauthier Hein leaves the pitch and Ibou Sane (Metz) comes on as a substitute.
87' 2 - 5 Goal! Endrick (Lyon) runs up to the ball, stops and waits for Jonathan Fischer to commit before slotting the penalty into the bottom left corner.
87' Endrick (Lyon) is heading towards the penalty spot to take it.

86' Eric Wattellier interrupts the game. One of the players from Metz won the ball, but his effort is adjudged unfair. The referee makes a call and blows his whistle for an infringement. Lyon are awarded a penalty.

85' Georgiy Tsitaishvili (Metz) takes a brilliant touch after he latches on to a pass on the edge of the box and strikes the ball to the bottom left corner. The goalkeeper dives low and saves his attempt.
83' A lofted cross from Benjamin Stambouli (Metz) is unsuccessful as the opponent's defence quickly clears the ball out of the penalty area.
82' The current number of shots on goal is 5:9.
79' The ball goes out of play and Lyon have been awarded a corner kick.
79' Mathys de Carvalho (Lyon) gets to the rebound just outside the box, but his attempt is blocked by one of the defending players. Lyon force their opponents to concede a corner.
78' Benoit Tavenot has decided to substitute Maxime Colin and he is replaced by Giorgi Abuashvili (Metz).
76' Lyon are dominating the game at the moment by exchanging a combination of one or two touch passes. Great harmony between the players.
73' The manager makes a subsitution with Mathys de Carvalho (Lyon) coming on for Khalis Merah.
70' We are about to witness a very dangerous free kick from the edge of the box! Gauthier Hein (Metz) will be the one to show us his shooting technique.
68' The referee signals a corner kick to Metz.

66' Benjamin Stambouli (Metz) connected with a pass around the edge of the box, aimed and shot. His attempt went towards the bottom left corner, but Dominik Greif was alert and the score remains the same.
64' 2 - 4 Habib Diallo (Metz) converts his chance into a goal!
62' We are about to witness a substitution. Believe Munongo (Metz) is replacing Jessy Deminguet.
62' Benoit Tavenot prepares a substitution. Terry Yegbe is replaced by Urie-Michel Mboula (Metz).
62' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Benjamin Stambouli (Metz) will replace Alpha Toure.
61' Endrick (Lyon) will deliver the corner kick.
61' Tyler Morton (Lyon) connects with a pass but sees his shot from the edge of the box blocked. The ball goes out of play. Lyon are awarded a corner kick.
60' 4:2 – these are the offside statistics for both sides in this match.
59' Wonderful movement by Lyon. The players are holding possession, mostly exchanging one-touch passes. They control the pace of the game now.
55' Habib Diallo (Metz) takes a shot after receiving a good pass, but his effort from the edge of the box goes just over the crossbar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Lyon.
54' Gauthier Hein (Metz) goes over to take the corner kick and it looks like he will send the ball into the penalty box.
52' Neat passing move from Metz in order to create new attacking opportunities.
48' Lyon force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.
46' Paulo Fonseca makes a half-time substitution. Moussa Niakhate (Lyon) comes on in place of Corentin Tolisso.
46' The referee blows his whistle to signal the start of the second half.
45+4' Eric Wattellier has ended the first half by blowing the whistle.
45+1' 1 - 4 Goal! Endrick (Lyon) pounced on a loose ball inside the box and beats the goalkeeper with a low shot into the middle of the net. He makes it 1:4.
45' The fourth official shows 3 min. of added time.
43' Koffi Kouao (Metz) gets the ball and drives a shot high over the bar from the edge of the area. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Lyon.
40' Metz seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.
39' Koffi Kouao (Metz) is awarded a yellow card. The referee showed him no mercy.
38' Corentin Tolisso (Lyon) makes a strong challenge and Eric Wattellier blows for a foul. There is a free kick near the sideline to Metz.
37' Great teamplay by Metz as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.
36' 1:5 – this is the current number of shots on target.
34' 1 - 3 Goal! It's a catastrophic error from the opponent which has gifted a chance to Koffi Kouao (Metz), who rolls the ball into the back of the net from close range. 1:3.

32' 0 - 3 The ball rebounds and arrives at the feet of Tyler Morton (Lyon) just outside the box. He doesn't think twice and fires a great shot into the bottom right corner. His attempt was beyond the reach of Jonathan Fischer, so the score changes to 0:3.
30' Jessy Deminguet (Metz) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack.
29' Gauthier Hein (Metz) is penalised for a foul. Eric Wattellier had a clear view and blows his whistle. Lyon win a free kick.
27' The ball goes behind for a corner. Metz will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
27' Georgiy Tsitaishvili (Metz) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
26' A pass by Ainsley Maitland-Niles (Lyon) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end.
23' Here comes the VAR verdict. NO GOAL for Lyon due to an offside in the build-up play.
23' Wait! Referee Eric Wattellier immediately makes the VAR signal, most likely to see if there was an offside in the build-up play.
22' GOAL DISALLOWED! Controversy and anger as Endrick (Lyon) has a goal ruled out, incredibly, for offside.
21' Gauthier Hein (Metz) tries to find the head of a teammate in the box but overhits the cross. The ball goes out of play and Lyon will have a goal kick.
19' Metz force a corner. They send men into the box.
16' 0 - 2 Goal! Ruben Kluivert (Lyon) receives a well-taken defence-splitting pass inside the box and fires the ball past the goalkeeper.
15' The referee points to the corner flag and Lyon will take a corner.
15' Endrick (Lyon) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out. Lyon have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
14' The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Metz will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.

14' Long passes, short passes and one-two passes. Metz are showcasing great team work by keeping possession and producing pin-point passes from player to player. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult to intercept at the moment.
11' 0 - 1 Goal! After receiving a sweet pass, Endrick (Lyon) unleashes a shot straight into the bottom left corner. Good team effort!
9' Lyon have been awarded a free kick just outside the penalty area, in a dangerous position.
8' Lyon are showing great team chemistry. They are passing it around beautifully. Excellent team work.
5' Terry Yegbe (Metz) commits a rough foul. Eric Wattellier stops the game and makes a call. A free kick has been awarded to Lyon.
2' Corentin Tolisso (Lyon) commits a foul during an attacking move. Metz get a free kick.
1' The first half has started.
The players are on the pitch and Metz will have the kick-off.
